clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Oslow needs tools for Lakeshire's defenses, but they lie beneath Lake Everstill. Sent from Goldshire, the chest went down when Blackrock orcs struck its boat with a catapult.

Foreman Oslow needs construction tools to keep Lakeshire's defenses and buildings in repair. Blackrock orcs besiege the Redridge Mountains, and the bridge into town lies destroyed. The tools came from Goldshire, so the shipment crossed Lake Everstill in a rowboat. Blackrock forces struck the vessel with a catapult, sending the boat and Oslow's heavy chest into the depths among the murlocs.
